entities.name: Go-Shintai of Ancient Wars
entities.description: A legendary mountaintop shrine housing a Kami of Ancient Wars.

entities.name: Kami of Ancient Wars
entities.description: Kami summoned by besieged Sokenzan rebels that still haunts the shrine hoping to start another fight.

entities.name: Sokenzan rebels
entities.description: Rebels who built the shrine while under siege.

events.summary: Sokenzan rebels under siege build a shrine and a Kami of Ancient Wars arms them with burning blades.
events.quote: A Kami of Ancient Wars came to their aid, arming them with burning blades.

events.summary: The fight lasts days until no one remains on either side.
events.quote: When the last soldier finally fell, no one remained on either side.

relations.note: Besieged by them and fought to the last.
relations.quote: a group of Sokenzan rebels fell under siege from an Imperial regiment.
